structured_output.what_is_happening: The news event is real and current. The White House launched "TRUMP TV: The Essentials Station", a 24/7 video stream, at 7pm ET on Monday 21 Sept 2026 (23:00 UTC). It came days after Trump barred CNN, MS NOW and Politico, on the same day those outlets sued (Forbes, Newsweek, Yahoo, KTRE). Within hours, at least 10 same-name TRUMPTV tokens were deployed on Solana. This one (7548Fk…) opened its PumpSwap pool at 01:21 UTC, about 2h20m after the launch. In roughly 55 minutes it logged $8.6M of volume against a market cap of only about $105k. The on-chain pattern looks manufactured rather than organic. GeckoTerminal shows 1,228 unique buyers but only 37 unique sellers, and those 37 made 4,218 sell transactions (about 114 each), which fits bot or wash cycling. Volume is about 82 times market cap. The top 10 holders own 97.3%. The creator wallet holds 883,865,250,978,366 raw units, which is about 88% of the 1B supply if the mint uses 6 decimals (I assumed that). The mint address has no "pump" suffix and no launchpad is detected, so this looks like a direct PumpSwap deployment, not a pump.fun bonding-curve graduate. For socials, the token links an X community whose snowflake ID dates to about March 2026, long before Trump TV existed, so it is recycled. GeckoTerminal describes the socials as themed on the 2024 election. The linked Telegram (t.me/thetrumptv) has 10 subscribers. I found no X, Reddit or news discussion that names this contract.

narrative.description: The White House's launch of 'Trump TV', its own 24/7 streaming channel, amid a press-ban fight and lawsuit with CNN, MS NOW and Politico. Mainstream outlets covered it widely on 21–22 Sept 2026.
narrative.why_spreading: It is a genuine, politically charged news story (press ban, lawsuit, a state-run-media angle) that is being covered by Forbes, Newsweek, Fox affiliates and local TV. Trump-branded launches reliably spawn memecoin copycats. The narrative has a ceiling, though: it is a video stream, not a crypto-related announcement, and it has no official token tie-in.

Its socials are a recycled X community created around March 2026 and a Telegram channel with 10 subscribers.

Most have zero current volume. This token was deployed later, at 01:21 UTC, so it is neither the first nor the canonical one. There is no official Trump TV token.

The X community is recycled and predates the event, and the Telegram has 10 subscribers. I found no organic social mentions of this contract.
